main_text.p: hæc[?] autoritas sacrosancta statuatur in Ecclesia, unde ruto & firmiter possimus controuersias fidei definire. Sed nec glossæ sententiam recte retulit Aquinas, nam integra glossæ verba sunt hæc: Gratia ergo, & auxilium quidam, qui est ad hominem conciliandum sanctum amorem, vleumdicitur[?] hæcille, ita Glossatoris verba peruertit Aquinas. Sed & glossator ipse Augustini sententiam, quæ eo loco referre voluit, non corrumpendi, sed abbreviandi studio, ab autoris mente detorsit. Augustini enim verba sunt: Quid est exhilaratio faciei in oleo? Gratia Dei, auxilium quidam in manifestatione, sicut dixit Apostolus, unicuique datur spiritus ad manifestationem. Hæc Augustinus.

Excuius rei observatione cordatus lector facile iudicare poterit, quibus modis, gradibus & incrementis zizania in agro dominico accreuerint, nam hic inimici hominis improbitatem certo deprehendere licet, & quasi furem, aut latronem in flagranti crimine tenere. Apostolus in agro dominico bonum semen seminauit, unicuique, inquit, datur manifestatio1. Cor. 12. 7.[?] spiritus ad utilitatem, loquitur Apostolus de donis spiritus, quæ dantur ad ædificationem aliorum, nam discrimina sunt inquit donorum, sed idem spiritus. Certum est Apostolum hic disputare, non de gratia iustificante, quæ dicitur à Theologis gratia gratum faciens: sed de donis Spiritus Sancti, & de gratia quæ dicitur à Scholasticis, gratis data. page.notes: The scan is heavily blurred and shows show-through from the reverse side in places, so the following readings are doubtful. "hæc" at the start of the page and "Excuius" are uncertain. "vleumdicitur" is largely illegible and is a guess. "glossator ipse" is partly obscured. The marginal reference "1. Cor. 12. 7." is only partly legible. The signature mark after "Ff" is unclear. The italic extent of "unicuique" and "inquit" is hard to judge. Printed text on the left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is excluded.
